decisions.reason: The LED supply and level-shifting decision does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
The decision concerns the separate 5V LED supply and data-level interface, not the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail.
The existing message-284 MODIFY already records that the switched 5V boost rail powers the LEDs and their logic; no additional or corrected update is required.
The charge-status indicator, GPIO assignment, and CHGLED connector behavior remain unchanged; LED power and level shifting are owned by the source Requirement.
The interboard connectors already include 5V and the source decision does not change their pinout, signal set, or numbering policy.
Adding a level shifter does not itself change any ESP32 GPIO assignment or the policy of retaining the existing pin arrangement.
The LED-board array remains a 16-LED addressable array; its count and type are unchanged, while supply and logic-level handling are represented by the source Requirement.
The LED voltage and level-shifter decision does not affect the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraint.
The source message establishes electrical behavior but does not change the board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, or mounting constraints.
The LED supply and logic-level interface do not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The level shifter is for the LED controller signal and does not change the I2C clock, pull-ups, cable length, or series resistors.
The source decision does not alter the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or net-label requirements.
